panel_a.ellipse_scope: Schematic magnification of the actual EE kernel aspect ratio and orientation, not its spatial length scale.
panel_a.core_boundaries: Exact physical circular core membership boundaries; dashed outline.
panel_a.working_point_scope: Author selected the same accepted demonstration as panels B/C/E on 2026-10-24; not the later global J_joint minimum.

panel_d.normalization: Each event uses its maximum spatial-bin activity over its full frozen event window; one denominator per row, shared across all times.
panel_d.selection: Same two historical events; author requested the 16-ms native activity frame instead of the 10-ms frame. Common elapsed milliseconds in both rows; nonuniform intervals explicitly labelled.
panel_d.early_frame_scope: The 16-ms frame displays early propagation around the initiating core. Activity is not required to remain strictly inside the core disk.
panel_d.time_origin: Separate 1%-total-peak initiation times; identical relative elapsed milliseconds in corresponding columns; no time rescaling.
panel_d.raw_frame_unit: E spikes per 2 ms per 1 mm², averaged across five consecutive native bins; omitted from normalized display.

panel_map.A: Same-workpoint core geometry and EE axis
panel_map.D: Same-workpoint MTA/MTB, five shared elapsed-time frames, normalized within each event
panel_map.F: Author-requested interim 17-patient shared-axis 1/2-core comparison at common completed search budget; TA-preferred constrained core1 versus unconstrained core2; true TA/TB labels

cohort_selection.author_decision: 2026-10-27: use shared-axis eligibility, update Fig5 first; identical Fig3/Fig5 patient list is not required
cohort_selection.rule: status=ok; geometry_2d_supported=true; saved shared_a and shared_b field models; intersect with the original 25-patient model cohort

display_contract.selection_policy: 1 core: minimum training J among finite rho_TA > rho_TB; 2 cores: original minimum training J
display_contract.significance_based_on: Holm-adjusted P; strict less-than threshold; nonsignificant annotation and bracket omitted

selection_policy.core1_constraint: signed rho_TA > signed rho_TB + 1e-12; both finite
selection_policy.core1_objective: minimum original training J among eligible candidates
selection_policy.inference: Post-hoc asymmetric selection-policy comparison; selection includes TB, so weaker TB is partly conditioned by design, not independent evidence of a core-count mechanism

paired_statistics.p_method: Exact conditional sign-permutation distribution of average ranks; dynamic programming
paired_statistics.multiple_comparison: Holm correction across the two template comparisons
paired_statistics.interpretation: Post-hoc asymmetric selection-policy comparison; the same template correlations enter core1 eligibility and scoring; no independent validation
paired_statistics.null: Patient-paired differences are symmetric about zero

named_template_paired_statistics.p_method: Exact conditional sign-permutation distribution of average ranks; dynamic programming
named_template_paired_statistics.multiple_comparison: Holm correction across the two template comparisons
named_template_paired_statistics.interpretation: Post-hoc asymmetric selection-policy comparison; the same template correlations enter core1 eligibility and scoring; no independent validation
named_template_paired_statistics.null: Patient-paired differences are symmetric about zero
